data.explanation: This letter confirms that your home contents insurance (Hausratversicherung) has been set up, covering household belongings up to 65,000 € starting on 01.10.2026. The annual premium of 96.60 € will be automatically collected from your bank account by direct debit (Lastschrift) at the start of the policy. The contract runs for one year and automatically renews for another year unless you cancel it in writing (Textform) at least three months before the end of the insurance year — the app will track that cancellation window for you. Keep this document safe as proof of insurance; no immediate action is required from you.
